brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Three full bases stacked at 0,0,0 / 0,0,1 / 0,0,2 (piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,0,1;full, piece:0,0,2;full) with snaps forming vertical column; half bases at 1,0,0-2 provide front face. Height = 3 levels (storeys).
Three drawers installed: drawer:0#1,0#cut at level 0, drawer:1#1,0#cut at level 1, drawer:2#1,0#cut at level 2, one per storey on half-n bases at 1,0,0 / 1,0,1 / 1,0,2.

finish.summary: Built a 3-level vertical column (0,0,0 - 0,0,2) with half-bases on east side providing drawer faces. Added three drawers, one per storey. check_build shows mesh clear with only warning/info.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
